about: FROZEN Deep held-out split (2026-10-23): 4 answerable multi-passage items and 4 lookalike decoys over the held-out corpus (Dracula, The Picture of Dorian Gray, Jane Eyre, A Tale of Two Cities, Candide; ACCEPTANCE_DB=veriforge_accept_heldout, GUTENBERG_SET=heldout). Written blind to system behaviour from my own knowledge before the corpus text was reopened; audit in evals/deep/heldout_audit.json. Same fields as test_items.json. Audited against the veriforge_accept_heldout database (it exists in the local db container). That database holds Candide as the FRENCH original (pg4650), so deep-ho-cross-pangloss-henry (mention 'Pangloss' is a name, valid in either language) and deep-ho-candide-baron-name are English questions over a French text. The audit found no wrong label. Not edited after the third commit (this note is that commit).

turns: Which ship carries Count Dracula to England, and at which seaside town does it run aground?
items.proof: Label written from my own knowledge of the book BEFORE the corpus text was reopened (audit afterwards). Demeter (Varna to England, log) and Whitby (it runs ashore in the storm).

turns: Who is the girl Jane befriends at school who dies of consumption, and at which estate does Jane afterwards become a governess?
items.proof: Label written from my own knowledge of the book BEFORE the corpus text was reopened (audit afterwards). Helen Burns at Lowood; Thornfield Hall (Rochester's estate, Adele's governess). Distant parts of the book.

turns: Who takes Charles Darnay's place at the guillotine, and whom had Darnay married in London?
items.proof: Label written from my own knowledge of the book BEFORE the corpus text was reopened (audit afterwards). Sydney Carton (book 3 end); Darnay married Lucie Manette (book 2).

turns: Who is Candide's philosophy tutor, and who is the cynical lord who influences Dorian Gray?
items.proof: Label written from my own knowledge of the book BEFORE the corpus text was reopened (audit afterwards). Two books: Dr. Pangloss; Lord Henry Wotton.

turns: What is Renfield's first name, and from which county was he committed to Dr. Seward's asylum?
items.proof: Decoy written from my own knowledge of the book BEFORE the corpus text was reopened (audit afterwards). Looks in-corpus (right book, right character, plausible detail) but I believe the text never states it: Renfield appears only as 'R. M. Renfield' and no first name or county of origin is given.
